links.outcome: Readability of LLM answers to cervical spine surgery patient questions (FKGL, FRES)
links.effect: ChatGPT-5.1 Auto FKGL 10.60 and FRES 39.50; DeepSeek-V3.1 Thinking FKGL 7.80 and FRES 61.70 (P<0.001). DeepSeek text was easier to read, and ChatGPT text was harder to read.
links.quote: While ChatGPT-5.1 Auto excelled in completeness, DeepSeek-V3.1 Thinking demonstrated superior readability.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates two LLMs answering frequently asked patient questions regarding cervical spine surgery, evaluated by spine surgeons and readability metrics, but it does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
